rule: Every sensitivity has its own immutable manifest, artifact namespace, expected-cell inventory, failure ledger, and approval-bound digest. No sensitivity cell is pooled into primary/v1.

namespaces.change: four registered semantic paraphrases and four leave-one-prompt-out analyses
namespaces.contrast_label: isolated fixed wording contrast within an otherwise identical cell

namespaces.change: global_unqualified versus five M49 region names
namespaces.contrast_label: isolated prompt-context label contrast; not a regional comparison of people, vacancies, markets, or demand

namespaces.change: L_total versus L_mean computed from the same retained token log probabilities
namespaces.contrast_label: isolated analytical transformation; token length remains tokenizer-dependent
confounded checkpoint comparison; incompatible tokenizers must never be swapped onto fixed weights and no isolated tokenizer contrast is currently available

namespaces.change: same-version Llama 3.1 8B versus 70B base checkpoints with the same documented cutoff
namespaces.contrast_label: scale-isolated to the strongest available degree, while width/depth and scale-specific training behavior are intrinsic to the scale change; feasibility approval required
confounded by architecture, tokenizer, nominal scale, corpus, and documented cutoff

namespaces.change: preregistered alternative role labels or code aggregation only
namespaces.contrast_label: isolated researcher taxonomy/rendering intervention where model and skill target are held fixed; semantics and wording intentionally change
isolated researcher taxonomy change; target wording, token length, and normalization reference set change by design
isolated researcher taxonomy change; target wording, token length, and normalization reference set change by design

additional_excluded_panels.label: instruction-tuning sensitivity under the registered plain-completion rendering; fine-tuning corpus remains confounded, chat rendering is not tested, and the panel is excluded from primary
within-checkpoint native chat-template rendering versus registered plain-completion rendering; native templates differ across revisions and this panel is excluded from primary
unknown-cutoff, publisher, architecture, tokenizer, and scale confounded; no temporal ordering

manifest_contract: Bind exact model and tokenizer revisions, role and skill taxonomy digests, prompt and estimand digests, namespace, changed dimension, fixed dimensions, scoring methods, expected cell IDs, software/environment identity, and approval digest.
Label every contrast isolated, partially isolated, or confounded with the named factors; an empty label is invalid.
A design-changing edit creates a new digest and approval. Existing approval cannot authorize a changed namespace manifest.
Unavailable models or tokenizers create failure-ledger and missing-cell records; substitution and silent omission are invalid.
